name: co.trooth/trooth
description: Every company's public record on the Trooth Network, and Semanto: a company's website, signed.
title: Trooth

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Start here
co.trooth/toolsets.what: trooth_setup, trooth_hub_sync, trooth_verify, setup status, enable_toolset, search_tools, call_tool (read-only tools) and call_write_tool (tools that change something).

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Public record
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Find a company and read its public record, one fact or its changes. No account.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Trust Profile
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Read, change, check and publish your own Trust Profile, and prove your domain.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Semanto
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Read the site, review and sign the facts, put the signed copy on the site and check it.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Developer
co.trooth/toolsets.what: The whole API (trooth_api_search, trooth_api_details, trooth_api_read, trooth_api_write), API keys, agent keys, webhooks, events, apps, Semanto connectors and signing keys.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Team and governance
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Team, roles, delegations, sessions, settings, notifications, the audit log, Semanto company settings and Google.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Commerce
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Buyers, attestations, reach, updates, media, Semanto credentials, recalls and seller lists.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Reports
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Semanto reports, benchmarks and reader exports.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Evidence and monitoring
co.trooth/toolsets.what: Connected sources, stack fixes, monitoring, evidence and documents.

co.trooth/toolsets.title: Semanto, every tool
co.trooth/toolsets.what: The rest of Semanto: listings and write-back, versions, the public log, keys and setup extras.
